assessment: This paper represents an important study for the microtubule cytoskeleton research community. By employing computational simulation, cell-free biophysical assays, and live-cell imaging, Gonzalez et al. convincingly reveal a mechanistic insight into the EB1 tip-tracking activity at the growing microtubule plus ends, preferential binding of GTP- over GDP-microtubule protofilaments does not fully explain the plus tip tracking of EB1. The authors show a binding preference of EB1 for protofilament edges over the closed lattice, which together with the nucleotide-state dependent dissociation rate of EB1 from the closed lattice successfully recapitulates the efficiency of EB1 tip tracking.
